text: In nineteen forty-three, a US Navy destroyer accidentally fired a torpedo at the battleship carrying the President.
The USS William D. Porter was practising, using the battleship Iowa as a pretend target. One torpedo had been left armed.
Under radio silence, they flashed a warning by lamp, and sent the wrong message. Then they broke radio silence.
Iowa turned hard, and the torpedo exploded in its wake. President Roosevelt asked to be wheeled to the rail to watch.
Dave was the one who armed it.
